# PR type
- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Fixes #10358

`_prepare_batch_inputs` 每次都会跑一遍前向来填 `old_per_token_logps`。但默认设置下（`num_iterations=1`，且 rollout 那批样本在同一个 optimizer step 内就消费完）,"更新前的策略"和"当前策略"是同一份权重——这次前向算出来的结果和 `per_token_logps.detach()` 完全一样，PPO 比值恒为 1，clip 项不起作用。算 loss 那里本来就靠这一点兜底（`old_per_token_logps = per_token_logps.detach() if ... is None else ...`），所以它根本不需要这个字段。

这次给那遍前向加了开关 `_need_old_per_token_logps`，复用了 trainer 里现成的 `old_policy()`，并在下列情况保留它——它们的共同点是**直接读这个字段、没有 `per_token_logps.detach()` 兜底**：
- `kl_in_reward`（KL 直接用这个字段算），只在 `beta != 0` 时
- teacher KL / RLSD / OPD（`teacher_per_token_logps`）
- Liger 路径和 rollout 重要性修正（`use_liger_kernel`、`rollout_per_token_logps`）
- `async_generate`

## Experiment results

在 H200 上插了临时探针：改动前 `old_per_token_logps` 不是 None，且每一步都与 `per_token_logps.detach()` 逐位相同（`torch.equal`，`max_abs_diff=0.0`）。改动后该字段为 None、走兜底，日志里所有指标不变——`loss`、`grad_norm`、`completions/{mean,min,max}_length`、`clipped_ratio`、`reward`、`reward_std`、`kl`、全部 `clip_ratio/*`，峰值显存也一致。

省掉的是什么 —— 在 H200 上用 Qwen2.5-0.5B 实测，一次「completion 前向 + 算 logps」的开销：

| batch × seqlen | tokens | 耗时 | 该次前向的峰值 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 × 1024 | 8192 | 65.2 ms | 5.80 GiB |
| 16 × 1024 | 16384 | 56.3 ms | 10.64 GiB |
| 16 × 2048 | 32768 | 109.2 ms | 20.31 GiB |

峰值的大头是 `[B, T, V]` 的 logits，不随模型变小而缩水；计算量随模型变大而增长，7B 上省的时间比这些数字大得多。

测试见 `tests/general/test_grpo_old_logps_gate.py`，纯 CPU，不需要 GPU 或模型。

# Checklist

- [x] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [x] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [x] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [x] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

nodes.body:
Hi @hjh0119 @tastelikefeet - sorry to ping directly. Same situation as #10337 from this fork: every workflow run is parked at `action_required`, so CI never runs.

This one drops the pre-update policy forward in GRPO when the weights cannot have moved (`num_iterations=1` and the rollout batch consumed within one optimizer step). A probe confirmed it is bit-for-bit identical to `per_token_logps.detach()` (`max_abs_diff=0.0`), and the logged metrics are unchanged after skipping it.

Could one of you approve the workflow runs when you get a chance?

                 if self.beta == 0.0:
                     ref_per_token_logps = None
                 elif self.ref_model is not None:
@@ -1831,6 +1832,20 @@ def training_step(self, model: nn.Module, inputs: DataType, num_items_in_batch=N
             self.eval_flag = False
         return super().training_step(model, inputs, num_items_in_batch)
 
+    def _need_old_per_token_logps(self, grpo_batch) -> bool:
+        """Whether the pre-update policy logps need a forward of their own.
+
+        With the default setup (`num_iterations=1` and the rollout batch consumed inside a single
+        optimizer step) the pre-update policy and the current policy are the same weights, so the
+        logps produced by this extra forward are bit-for-bit identical to
+        `per_token_logps.detach()` — the forward is pure overhead. It is only worth computing when
+        the weights can actually have moved, or when something reads the field directly without the
+        `per_token_logps.detach()` fallback used at the loss site.
+        """
+        return bool(self.old_policy() or (self.kl_in_reward and self.beta != 0.0)
+                    or grpo_batch.teacher_per_token_logps is not None or grpo_batch.rollout_per_token_logps is not None
+                    or self.args.async_generate or self.args.use_liger_kernel)
+
     def old_policy(self):
         if self.template.sequence_parallel_size == 1:
             return (self.num_iterations > 1

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from swift.rlhf_trainers.grpo_trainer import GRPOTrainer
+
+_need_old_per_token_logps = GRPOTrainer._need_old_per_token_logps
+
+
+def make_trainer(**kwargs):
+    trainer = dict(
+        old_policy=lambda: False,
+        kl_in_reward=False,
+        beta=0.0,
+        args=SimpleNamespace(async_generate=False, use_liger_kernel=False),
+    )
+    trainer.update(kwargs)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**trainer)
+
+
+def make_batch(**kwargs):
+    batch = dict(teacher_per_token_logps=None, rollout_per_token_logps=None)
+    batch.update(kwargs)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**batch)
+
+
+class TestNeedOldPerTokenLogps(unittest.TestCase):
+    """The extra forward over the pre-update policy is only skipped when it is provably redundant."""
+
+    def test_default_setup_skips_the_forward(self):
+        # num_iterations=1, single optimizer step, no reader without a fallback.
+        self.assertFalse(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(), make_batch()))
+
+    def test_multiple_iterations_keep_the_forward(self):
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(old_policy=lambda: True), make_batch()))
+
+    def test_kl_in_reward_keeps_the_forward_only_with_beta(self):
+        # kl_in_reward computes its KL straight from the field, with no `per_token_logps` fallback.
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(kl_in_reward=True, beta=0.1), make_batch()))
+        self.assertFalse(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(kl_in_reward=True, beta=0.0), make_batch()))
+
+    def test_teacher_kl_keeps_the_forward(self):
+        batch = make_batch(teacher_per_token_logps=object())
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(), batch))
+
+    def test_rollout_logps_keep_the_forward(self):
+        # The Liger path reads the field directly to build the rollout importance ratio.
+        batch = make_batch(rollout_per_token_logps=object())
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(make_trainer(), batch))
+
+    def test_async_generate_keeps_the_forward(self):
+        trainer = make_trainer(args=SimpleNamespace(async_generate=True))
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(trainer, make_batch()))
+
+    def test_liger_kernel_keeps_the_forward(self):
+        trainer = make_trainer(args=SimpleNamespace(async_generate=False, use_liger_kernel=True))
+        self.assertTrue(_need_old_per_token_logps(trainer, make_batch()))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
